even during first usage of context

messages.reasoning_content: This matches upstream zstd fix "Fix Window Initialization" (PR #1492?): base initialized as `ip - 1`? Actually upstream commit "fix #1490" — in ZSTD_window_update init, base = ip - distanceFromBase where distanceFromBase 0 gives index 0 problem. The fix: initialize window base such that first position valid... Upstream fix: in `ZSTD_window_init`, set `base = ip - 1` ... Let me recall: commit "Ensure first position is valid even with no extDict / first usage" — actual upstream change in ZSTD_window_update: `window->base = ip - distanceFromBase;` stays; the fix was in zstd_compress.c where window init sets `nextSrc = ip` then base = ip - 1? Let me find window init.
